bio: My thesis is a high-heat-flux, closed-loop two-phase thermosyphon for EV thermal management. I study how texturing the evaporator surface changes bubble dynamics, flow-regime transitions and boiling heat transfer.

Beyond thermal-fluids, I have built a blended regenerative and friction braking controller on an STM32 with hardware-in-the-loop testing, and a four-degree-of-freedom stability model of a motorcycle. I did my B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering at JNTUA College of Engineering, Ananthapuramu.
